evidence: LINKAGE SECTION with USING clause on PROCEDURE DIVISION
COPY statements without REPLACING (typical GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL style)
Project name 'ORCA' - known Japanese open-source medical receipt system using GnuCOBOL

purpose.summary: This is a screen-handling subprogram (PID1 confirmation screen) within the ORCA JMA standard medical receipt software system. It handles screen navigation events (LINK, PUTG/CLICKED) and manages transitions between screens, setting SPA flags and calling ORCDBMAIN to put/display windows.

notable_features: Part of the ORCA (JMA standard receipt software) open-source Japanese medical system
Heavy use of COPY statements for screen and data area definitions
EVALUATE with ALSO for multi-condition branching
LINKAGE SECTION used for inter-program communication via MCP (Message Control Program) areas
Japanese comments encoded in latin-1 (originally Shift-JIS or EUC-JP, garbled in latin-1 decoding)
MCP-STATUS/MCP-EVENT/MCP-WIDGET pattern typical of ORCA GUI framework
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS
verdict.notes: The Japanese comments are garbled due to latin-1 decoding of what was originally EUC-JP or Shift-JIS encoded text. The program is clearly part of the well-known ORCA open-source Japanese medical receipt system, which runs on GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL. The high comment ratio (52%) is due to the extensive Japanese comment blocks and commented-out COPY statements.
